text: The July Revolution of 2024 was a pivotal moment in Bangladesh's history, driven by students and citizens demanding justice and reform. What began as protests for civil service quota reform rapidly escalated into a mass uprising that ultimately toppled a longstanding government. You will experience these tumultuous days through the eyes of ordinary people caught in extraordinary circumstances. Please note that this is a work of historical fiction inspired by real events. While the broader context is factual, the characters and their personal journeys are fictional composites.
